_comment: Diagnostic ablations of the best single-pass GWS config (T=6, beta=3, eta=0.003, L=2, B=16). Questions: (1) eta0: does the learned denominator matter, or is GWS an unnormalized exp-kernel machine with a fixed D_0 normalizer? (2) noclip: effect of the undocumented clip of <s,g>/B to [-1,1]. (3) eta_hi: larger weight learning rate. (4) rbf_T6: RBF at the same temperature as GWS; on the sphere RBF == exp(-sqrt(d)/T) * exp(<q,k>/(T sqrt d)), so this isolates normalization. (5) L0/L1: depth.
